title: IndiGo Flight Cancellations Explained | What Went Wrong
description:
In early December, thousands of passengers across India were stranded as IndiGo flights were delayed or cancelled nationwide. Airports turned chaotic, families were left waiting for hours, and the country witnessed one of the biggest aviation disruptions in recent years.

In this documentary, we break down what passengers actually faced on the ground, what really caused the IndiGo flight crisis, how pilot fatigue rules, poor rostering, and lack of competition pushed the system to collapse, and why this wasn’t just one airline’s failure but a warning sign for Indian aviation as a whole.

We also examine IndiGo’s response, the role of DGCA and the government, why screaming at airport staff doesn’t fix systemic failures, and what must change to protect passengers in the future.

This video explains the IndiGo chaos, Indian aviation crisis, flight cancellations, DGCA rules, pilot fatigue laws, airline monopoly issues, and passenger rights from a factual, rational perspective.

If you’ve searched for IndiGo flight cancellations, IndiGo chaos, Indian aviation crisis, DGCA rules, or pilot fatigue rules, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share.
